任务的停止与调整时限: Stopping a task and changing its time limit
点开「任务」里的一个任务：进行中的可以暂停或停止（分轮出题的叫「停在这里」，已通: Open a task in “Jobs”: a running one can be paused or stopped (a task that works in rounds says “Stop here” and keeps every question that passed), and a stopped one can be continued with “Continue”. The details give the time limit and the time used; when the limit comes from settings, “Adjust time budget” takes you to “Settings › Question defaults” to change the time limit of each round. It only applies to tasks that start afterwards.
把这一页或这一章译成中文或英文，译文显示在对应段落旁；翻译在后台进行，可以继续阅: Translates this page or chapter into Chinese or English, with the translation shown beside each paragraph. It runs in the background so you can keep reading, and a translation you already have needs no model.
选中一段原文后，可以把题补到一个现有题组里：生成的题经过独立审核，通过的增量保存: After selecting a passage you can add questions to an existing deck: the generated questions are reviewed independently, the ones that pass are saved incrementally and linked to that passage.
资料先归档，之后可以恢复，只有已归档的资料才能永久删除。页面右上角的「已归档」列: A material is archived first and can be restored later; only an archived material can be deleted for good. “Archived” at the top right lists the materials that were put away; each row’s “More” menu has “Archive”; and after ticking several under “Organize courses” you can use “Archive selected”.
勾选资料后统一改它们属于哪门课，原文与引用保持不变；也可以先点「请 AI 建议」: Tick materials and change which course they belong to in one go; the text and citations stay as they are. You can also click “Suggest with AI” first and apply the suggestions after reading them.
文字读不出来、公式多，或超过 8 MB 的 PDF，可以先在本机解析成带页码的文: A PDF whose text cannot be read, has many formulas or is over 8 MB can first be parsed on this computer into text with page numbers and then saved as a material. It is part of the audio component and uses MinerU or Marker.
已经有题目，或是别的 AI 生成的题，可以直接导入：JSON 题组会存为草稿，检: If you already have questions, or questions made by another AI, import them directly: a JSON deck is saved as a draft, to be checked and then published.
长案例加开放题，按评分标准逐项批改；这门课考案例题时，在这里出题。: A long case with open questions, graded criterion by criterion. If your course has a case exam, make questions here.
给一次出题设一个 token 上限（例如 2M）：用到了就在一轮结束时停下，已通: Set a token limit for one run (for example 2M): when it is used up, the run stops at the end of a round and keeps every question that passed. Leave it empty for no limit.
这次出的题偏基础还是偏难：混合、基础理解、应用迁移、深入辨析。默认值在「设置 ›: Whether this run’s questions lean basic or hard: mixed, foundational, applied or in-depth. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
这次出的题用什么语言写：中文、English 或中英双语。默认值在「设置 › 出: The language this run’s questions are written in: Chinese, English or both. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
题目里的公式怎么写：自动、纯文本或公式（LaTeX）。纯文本更稳定，公式适合数学: How formulas are written in questions: automatic, plain text or formula (LaTeX). Plain text is steadier; formulas suit maths and chemistry. The default is changed in “Settings › Question defaults”.
写一句这次想练什么（例如「区分相似模式，重点练习工程场景中的取舍」），出题会侧重: Write a line about what you want to practise (for example “tell similar patterns apart, practise trade-offs in engineering cases”) and the questions lean towards it. You can also make questions without it.
不知道练什么时点它：它只发送资料标题和目录，不发送全文；没有模型时，会改用你的错: Click it when you do not know what to practise: it sends only the material titles and outline, never the full text, and without a model it suggests from your mistakes instead.
上传自己教材里的优质题目，或选已导入的样题：出题只参考题型、难度和表达方式，要求: Upload good questions from your own textbook, or pick sample questions you already imported: they are used only for question type, difficulty and wording, new questions are still original, and facts and answers still follow the textbook. The chosen samples are sent to the model with the materials, which adds input tokens.
草稿里还有资料小节没有题时，点它按小节补一轮题；开着「自动补到完整」会一轮接一轮: When a draft still has parts of the materials without questions, click it to top up one round by part. With “Fill up automatically” on, rounds follow one another until every part has questions. The cost is estimated first. The Study library’s unpublished row and “Jobs” have this entry too.
草稿页的「覆盖」一栏用一行写覆盖了几个小节、占百分之几，下面一句话说出题计划是否: The “Coverage” box on the draft page gives one line with how many sections have a question and what percent that is, and one sentence under it saying whether the question plan is finished and how many sections are outside it; how the rounds were split is in “Generation details” on the draft page. A question task in Tasks has the same box, where “Plan progress” only says how much of the plan is done.
页面底部的操作栏: Action bar at the foot of the page
草稿页底部操作栏里的「更多」（⋯）菜单：点「删除草稿」会先问一次，确认后永久删除: In the “More” (⋯) menu in the action bar at the foot of the draft page: “Delete draft” asks once, and after you confirm it permanently deletes the questions of this draft that are not published yet; the materials and published decks stay.
点开「任务」里一个已结束的任务，详情右上角的「更多」（⋯）菜单里有「删除任务记录: Open a finished task in “Tasks”: the “More” (⋯) menu at the top right of its detail has “Delete task record”. The record leaves the list at once and can be undone for a few seconds; materials, drafts and decks stay. A running task cannot be deleted. You can also tick several finished tasks and delete them together from the bar above the list.
AI 出的题先放进草稿：你可以逐题核对、修改或删除，确认无误再发布，发布后就能开: Questions made by AI go into a draft first: check, edit or delete them one by one, then publish, and you can start practising. “Save & validate” and “Publish and start practising” are in the action bar at the foot of the page, which stays in view while you scroll through the questions.
草稿页「题目」一栏里折叠着「高级编辑」，里面的「JSON 编辑」可以直接用 JS: On the draft page, “Advanced editing” is folded in the “Questions” section; its “Edit JSON” changes this draft directly as JSON.
做题时点「提示」先看线索；揭晓答案以后，它变成「讲解」。按 H 键也能打开。: Click “Hint” while answering to see a clue; once the answer is revealed it becomes “Explanation”. The H key opens it too.
卡住了点它：后台助教会结合原文讲解这道题、补上前置知识，讲完送进信箱，不打断你做: Click it when you are stuck: a background tutor explains the question with the original text and fills in the prerequisites, then sends it to your inbox without interrupting you.
把想法存下来：在题目下方的「更多」里选「写笔记」。存下的笔记收在「学习笔记」里，: Keep your thoughts: choose “Write a note” in “More” below the question. Saved notes are collected in “Study notes” and can jump back to the question.
把这道题移入斩题组，不再复习；斩掉的当时可以点「撤销」，恢复到原题组。: Moves this question to the slain deck so it is no longer reviewed; right then you can click “Undo” to put it back in its deck.
选好这一轮练什么（只练错题、加上同类题，或加上变式），点「开始重练」，把待巩固的: Choose what this round covers (the mistakes only, with similar questions, or with variants) and click “Start retraining” to go through the questions that need work again along the learning path; after filtering you can also practise only the filtered ones, and with several groups each one has its own “Practise this group”.
点开一道错题的详情，能看到题库里已有的同类题，可以直接去练；页面上的「为你推荐」: Open the details of a mistake to see similar questions already in your bank and practise them directly; “Recommended for you” on the page is the same kind of thing, and to practise them with your mistakes choose “Mistakes + similar” under Retrain.
为错题改写新的变式题：每道题约 1 次轻量模型调用，一次有题数上限；错题只有一道: Rewrites mistakes as new variant questions: about one light model call per question, with a limit on how many at a time. With one mistake use the “Generate variants” beside it; with several the page also has “Generate variants for all mistakes”. Finished ones go to “Personalised”; click “Practise” to start.
直接从题库里找相似的题：同主题、引用同一页，或关键词相近，已排除你刚答对的；不消: Finds similar questions straight from your bank: same topic, citing the same page or close keywords, leaving out ones you just got right. It uses no model. This line only says what was found; to practise them choose “Mistakes + similar” under Retrain and click “Start retraining”.
列表上方的筛选栏: The filter row above the list
错题满 10 道，列表上方才出现这一排：按主题或按题组分组、全部展开 / 全部收: This row appears above the list once you have 10 mistakes: group by topic or by deck, expand or collapse all, filter by deck, status or text, and “Only this deck” beside each group. With fewer than 10 you can see everything at a glance, so the row is left out.
错题页不再有「刷新」按钮：打开着的时候它每隔几秒自己看一眼，有新的错题或错题已订: The mistakes page no longer has a Refresh button: while it is open it checks for itself every few seconds and updates when there is a new mistake or one has been corrected, leaving the groups and questions you opened as they are.
同一天、同一课程只保留一篇合集，累计完成 10 道不同题目才生成；默认关闭，开启: Only one collection is kept per day and course, and it is made once you have finished 10 different questions. It is off by default and uses the current AI model when on. The collections are kept in “Study notes”.
后台替你做完的事（改题、前置题、讲解、译文、批改、音频转写、PDF 转换……）都: What the background finished for you (question fixes, prerequisites, explanations, translations, grading, audio transcription, PDF conversion…) is delivered to the inbox. Click an item to jump back to that question or result; “Mark all as read” only clears the badge and deletes nothing.
在这里切换选择题笔试、案例分析卷和口头面试，都是限时作答；交卷后给出成绩单和逐题: Switch here between the multiple-choice written exam, the case paper and the oral interview, all timed. After you hand in you get a report and an explanation for each question, and the case paper is graded criterion by criterion.
每门课可以记下考试形式、总分、作答和阅读时间、考试日期，也能放入老师的考试说明、: Each course can record the exam format, total marks, answering and reading time and exam date, and can hold your teacher’s exam notes, key topics and an optional target role and JD (for written or oral interview preparation); the days left until the exam show beside the course title. Choose “Course settings…” at the end of the course title’s menu, or go to “Settings › Courses”.
课堂实录可以用 Gemini（云端，要密钥），也可以用本地转写：声音不上传，不需: Live class can use Gemini (cloud, needs a key) or local transcription: the sound is not uploaded, no key is needed, and it has to be installed first. Choose in “Settings › Audio transcription”; it can also be installed on the “Live class” page.
学习库是你电脑上的一个文件夹，资料、题组和复习记录都保存在里面；在这里选它放在哪: The library is a folder on your computer that holds your materials, decks and review records; choose here which folder it is.
出题、讲解和提问需要一个 AI 模型，在这里选用哪个；模型的密钥在 DSH 的「: Making questions, explanations and asking need an AI model; choose which one here. The model’s key goes in DSH’s “Settings › Model”, not here.
转写录音要填一个密钥：按 Gemini 免费、硅基流动、Groq、Gemini: Transcribing a recording needs a key: they are tried in the order free Gemini, SiliconFlow, Groq, paid Gemini, and one is enough. From mainland China choose SiliconFlow, which connects directly and needs no overseas network.
给上百页的大教材用：在「设置 › 检索扩展」的「检索：只让 AI 看相关页面」装: For textbooks of hundreds of pages: install the search extension and build the index of the course in “Settings › Search extension”, under “Search: let the AI see only the relevant pages”. After that, making questions from a whole book reads only the relevant pages, which uses fewer tokens and stays on topic; a selection over 150,000 characters is narrowed with it first. The index is built on this computer: no AI is called, it uses no tokens and your material never leaves the computer; the first build downloads a search model of about 90 MB, once. For a book of 150 pages or more that has no index yet, “Build the search index first” appears under the file list of Add source, on the finished conversion card and its Conversion history row beside “Customize this book in depth”, and in More › Whole book; the line above the list on the Create deck and Sources pages (“N materials have no finished index · Build index”) does the same, and its hover says what the index is for. Click any of them to come straight here.
换一个强调色：朱砂是默认，另有几种可选。只换强调色，其他不变。: Pick an accent colour: cinnabar is the default and a few others are available. Only the accent changes.
选界面字体和标题字体；也可以填本机已安装的字体名，找不到会用系统字体。: Choose the interface font and the heading font; you can also type the name of a font installed on this computer, and the system font is used if it cannot be found.
调卡片、按钮这些东西的圆角大小。: Adjust how rounded cards, buttons and similar things are.
高对比会加深边框和次要文字、加粗焦点框；跟随系统时，遵循系统的“增加对比度”设置: High contrast darkens borders and secondary text and thickens the focus ring; when it follows the system, it obeys the system’s “Increase contrast” setting.
把整套外观带到另一台电脑：点「复制外观设置」（或「下载为文件」），在那边点「导入: Move the whole look to another computer: choose “Copy appearance settings” (or “Save as file”), then on the other one choose “Import appearance” and paste or pick the file. You see it once “More appearance options” is open.
一键把语言以外的外观（明暗、强调色、大小、字体、动画、对比度、密度、圆角）都改回: Put every appearance setting except the language (light or dark, accent colour, size, fonts, animation, contrast, density, corners) back to its default in one click.
看这一页能用的键；按 ? 也能打开。: See the keys that work on this page; pressing ? opens it too.
切到每个关键功能，边走边看怎么用。先走主线（模型、资料、出题、草稿、练习），看完: Switches to each key feature so you can see how it works. It starts with the main chain (model, materials, questions, draft, practice) and you can then take the full tour; pause any time and continue later.
把鼠标放上去（或用键盘聚焦），会列出界面里这些词的意思：主会话、总纲、覆盖强度、: Hover over it (or focus it with the keyboard) to list what these words in the interface mean: main chat, course outline, coverage strength, prerequisite questions, study library and deck.
载入过示例课程后，可以在这里移除示例数据，你自己的资料和记录不受影响；也可以重新: After the sample course has been loaded you can remove the sample data here; your own materials and records are not affected. You can also load the sample again or retake the tour.
导出会下载一个完整的 JSON 备份：资料、题组、复习进度和作答记录都在里面。恢: Export downloads a complete JSON backup with your materials, decks, review progress and answer records. Restore replaces the current library with a complete backup, and the current data is saved automatically first.
从已有的本地学习库（study-lib-spar）导入，保留可迁移的复习记录。: Import from an existing local library (study-lib-spar), keeping the review records that can be moved.
看当前版本、已安装版本和最新已知版本，检查更新；有新版本时，侧栏底部也会提示。: See the current, installed and latest known versions and check for updates; the bottom of the sidebar also says so when a new version is out.
只记录你用了哪些控件、各用了多少次（按天累计），不记录任何内容和名字；只保存在这: Records only which controls you used and how many times (per day), never any content or names; it stays on this computer and can be viewed, exported, paused and deleted any time. Off by default.
显示实验性功能的总开关，默认关闭；关掉后它们全部隐藏并停止，里面已有的选择会保留: The master switch for showing experimental features, off by default; when off they are all hidden and stopped, and choices already made in them are kept.
内置功能做不了的事，点「发给主会话」：StudyHub 把写好的话填进主会话的输: For what the built-in features cannot do, click “Send to the main chat”: StudyHub puts the message into the main chat’s input box and you press send; without a main chat it is copied to the clipboard.
输入一个词（中文、英文或常见叫法都行）就能找到功能在哪，选中后「带我去」会切到那: Type a word (Chinese, English or a common name all work) to find where a feature is; after selecting it, “Take me there” switches to that page and puts the focus on the control. Press Ctrl K (⌘K on a Mac), or / when no text field has the focus, to open it too.
语言、外观、强调色、界面大小在最上面；字体、动画、对比度、密度和圆角在「更多外观: Language, appearance, accent colour and interface size are at the top; fonts, animation, contrast, density and corners are in “More appearance options”; you can also copy the look or save it as a file and take it to another computer
公式的大小和对齐、图片的显示方式，以及化学配平和代数恒等式两个在本地计算的小工具: Formula size and alignment, how images are shown, and two small tools that compute locally: chemical balancing and algebraic identity checking
选学习库放在哪个文件夹，也选用哪个模型出题；模型的密钥在 DSH 的「设置 ›: Choose which folder the library lives in and which model makes questions; the model’s key goes in DSH’s “Settings › Model”
新出题任务的默认值：题型、覆盖强度、语言、难度、公式写法，以及同时处理几批、每轮: Defaults for new question-making tasks: question types, coverage, language, difficulty, formula notation, how many batches run at once, the time limit of each round and how many extra rounds fill in automatically
把一天里答错的题整理成一篇讲解合集：是否自动准备、默认的讲解口吻和按哪个时区算一: Turns the questions you got wrong in a day into one explanation collection: whether it is prepared automatically, the default tone and which time zone counts as a day
每天的练习怎么走：每轮题数、自动跳下一步、本轮点评，以及期末一周的安排: How the daily practice goes: questions per round, auto-advance, the round comment and the final-week plan
列出每门课；点开一门课可以记下考试形式、日期、总分和重点知识点，也能把两门课合并: Lists every course; open one to record the exam format, date, total marks and key topics, or merge two courses
备考补习的个人默认值：是否自动识别资料用途、清单语言，以及是否默认列出其它课程的: Your defaults for Exam prep: whether material roles are recognised automatically, the checklist language and whether materials of other courses are listed by default
填转写用的密钥（Gemini 或国内能直连的硅基流动），也选课堂实录用云端还是本: Enter the key used for transcription (Gemini, or SiliconFlow which connects directly from mainland China) and choose whether live class uses the cloud or local transcription
把扫描件、公式多或很大的 PDF 先在本机解析成带页码的文字：安装 MinerU: Parse scanned, formula-heavy or very large PDFs on this computer into text with page numbers: install MinerU or connect Marker
给上百页的大教材用：装好后，整本书出题时只挑出相关页面给 AI 看: For textbooks of hundreds of pages: once installed, making questions from a whole book shows the AI only the relevant pages
载入或移除示例课程、重新看功能导览，也管理陪学的学习画像: Load or remove the sample course, retake the feature tour and manage the study-coach profile
各处提示和引导什么时候出现，以及 AI 带学的默认设置: When each tip and guide appears, and the default settings of AI-guided study
从旧学习库导入、间隔复习（FSRS-6）的参数，以及整个学习库的备份与恢复: Import from an old library, the spaced review (FSRS-6) parameters, and backup and restore of the whole library
报问题时用：复制一段文字，里面只有版本、界面语言、页面、出错类型、程序自带的报错: Use this when you report a problem: it copies a text with only the version, interface language, page, error type, the program's own short error phrase, the names of the functions where it broke, job kinds and statuses, the number of sources, decks and questions, and whether experimental features are on. Any other error text is not copied, only its length. You can read the text before copying, and you add the DSH version yourself. When a page fails, the failure notice has the same button.
看当前版本和最新已知版本，检查更新；有新版本时在这里升级: See the current and latest known versions, check for updates and upgrade here when there is a new one
只在这台电脑上记你用了哪些功能、各用了几次；默认关闭，可以随时查看、导出、暂停和: Records on this computer only which features you used and how often; off by default, and it can be viewed, exported, paused and deleted any time
显示实验性功能的总开关；默认关闭，打开后才出现还在试验的功能: The master switch for experimental features; off by default, and only when it is on do the features still being tried appear
先开始一轮练习，题目下方就有这一项。: First start a round of practice; this is below the question.
先开始一轮练习，点题目下方的「更多」，菜单里就有这一项。: First start a round of practice and click “More” below the question; this is in the menu.
先在学习库里打开一份待发布的草稿。: First open an unpublished draft in the Study library.
先在「资料」里添加资料，这一项才会出现。: First add materials in “Sources”; only then does this appear.
答错过题以后，这一项才会出现。: This appears once you have got some questions wrong.
先在「任务」里点开一个任务，这一项在任务的详情里。: First open a task in “Jobs”; this is in the task’s details.
点「添加资料」，在弹出的窗口里就有这一项。: Click “Add materials”; this is in the window that opens.
搜一个功能在哪；什么都不输入，就是完整的索引。: Look up where a feature is; with nothing typed, it is the full index.
输入功能名，例如 翻译、花费上限: Type a feature, for example translate or spending limit
没找到『{0}』。试试换个说法，或打开功能导览。: Nothing found for ‘{0}’. Try another wording, or open the feature tour.
搜一个功能在哪，选中后直接带你过去: Look up where a feature is; select it and it takes you there
这个 DSH 里没有开启{0}: {0} is not turned on in this DSH
这个 DSH 里没有启用它需要的组件：{0}: This DSH does not have the component it needs: {0}
找功能：搜一个功能在哪，选中后直接带你过去（/ 在没有输入框聚焦时可用）: Find a feature: look up where a feature is and go straight there (/ works when no text field has the focus)
选界面的明暗和配色（也有纯黑和护眼纸色）；选「跟随系统」就随电脑的深浅色变。: Choose light or dark and the colours (there is also pure black and an easy-on-the-eyes paper tone); “System” changes with your computer's light or dark mode.
在中文和 English 之间切换界面语言；默认跟随浏览器的语言。: Switch the interface between Chinese and English; by default it follows your browser's language.
侧栏上方是最常用的几项，其余的按内容收在「更多」里：资料与出题、练习与复习、考试: The top of the sidebar holds the pages you use most; everything else is in “More”, grouped by what it is about: Materials and questions, Practice and review, Exams and statistics, and Tasks, notes and to-dos. Hold an item and drag it up to put it with the ones you use most (at most 6; when they are full, drag one of them into “More” first); with the keyboard, press Alt with the up or down arrow.
侧栏底部的「帮助」里有功能导览、快捷键和名词解释。: “Help” at the bottom of the sidebar holds the feature tour, the keyboard shortcuts and the glossary.
窗口窄时，或把侧栏收起后，点顶栏左边的菜单按钮打开导航，每一项都带名字；按 Es: In a narrow window, or after you put the sidebar away, the menu button at the left of the top bar opens the navigation, with every item named; Esc or a click outside closes it. When the window is wide enough, “Keep the sidebar on the left” in the navigation puts it back.
在题目下方的「更多」里打开「显示英文」，中文题干和答案后面就会显示英文。: Turn on “Show English” in “More” below the question and English appears after the Chinese question and answer.
在题目下方的「更多」里选「字号与版心…」，调字号、版心宽度、字体和背景，还有「排: Choose “Text size and width…” in “More” below the question to change the text size, text width, font and background, plus “Fine-tune layout”. It only affects reading and practice text, not the whole interface.
在题目下方的「更多」里选「这题不错」或「这题有问题…」；选后者可以再选标签（题干: Choose “Good question” or “Something is wrong with it…” in “More” below the question; after the second you can pick tags (vague stem, poor options, too easy, too hard, wrong answer, unclear explanation, only asks what the source says). The keys are G / B.
答对后自动进入下一题，点任意处或按键可以停下；在题目下方的「更多」里开关，按 A: After a correct answer it moves on to the next question by itself; click anywhere or press a key to stop it. Switch it in “More” below the question, or press A. The default is in “Settings › Practice”.
出题时资料要覆盖到什么程度：精简、标准、完整，或「自定义」一个题数；选得越完整，: How completely the materials are covered: Lean, Standard, Full, or a Custom number of questions; the fuller, the more questions and the more it costs. Before the run, the tokens it will probably use are estimated from the real prompts.
想自己定题数时，在「覆盖强度」里选「自定义」，填一个数或点常用题数；超过 30: To choose the number of questions yourself, pick “Custom” in “Coverage strength” and type a number or click a common one. More than 30 are split into rounds of at most 30. Pick Lean, Standard or Full again and the number no longer applies.
一轮出不完的计划，开着它会一轮接一轮自动做完；关掉就只出第 1 轮，其余的在草稿: A plan that does not fit in one round goes on round after round by itself while this is on; turn it off and only round 1 is made, and each other round is added on the draft page with “Add questions for the uncovered parts”. Lean does not go on by itself by default; Standard and Full do.
为面试准备出题时，写下目标岗位或面试方向（例如「后端工程师 · 系统设计」），出: When preparing for an interview, write the target role or focus (for example “backend engineer · system design”) and the questions are adjusted to it. Ordinary course questions do not need it; it is folded under “Interview focus” in “More options”.
这次出哪几种题：单选测验、多选测验、判断题、闪卡、开放问答、填空卡、动手任务，可: Which kinds of question to make this time: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, flashcards, open response, fill in the blank, hands-on task. You can pick several, and the total is shared between them. The defaults are in “Settings › Question preferences”.
动手任务不在应用内提供编辑器、也不运行测试：你在本地写完代码、SQL、推导或方案: Hands-on tasks have no in-app editor and never run tests: after writing your code, SQL, derivation or design locally, choose “Check in main chat” so the main chat reads only the files you specify, checks each acceptance criterion as satisfied, missing or issue (pointing out at most 3 issues without editing your files) and writes the result back to StudyHub; you can also choose “View reference solution” (recorded as having viewed the solution) or “Done (self-report)” (recorded as self-reported, unverified).
新题组默认放进你勾选的资料所在的课程（资料列表上方的「课程范围」只用来筛选资料）: The new deck goes into the course of the materials you ticked by default (the “Course scope” above the list of materials only filters the materials); click “Change” to pick or create another course, or leave it empty for uncategorised.
课堂实录多久没有新文字（本地转写：多久没有声音）就算一句话说完。老师讲得快、几乎: How long live class waits with no new text (local transcription: no sound) before a sentence counts as finished. For a lecturer who talks fast and hardly pauses, choose “Short”: sentences appear sooner, and polishing and questions can start sooner. It takes effect the next time you start or resume recording.
课堂实录的润色状态与重试: Polish status and retry in live class
逐字稿上方的「上下文润色」一行: The “Context polish” line above the transcript
逐字稿上方的「上下文润色」一行写着已检查、已润色和已跳过几句；有句子太长或超时被: The “Context polish” line above the transcript says how many sentences were checked, polished and skipped. A sentence that was too long or timed out is skipped (its original text is kept), and an error shows on the same line: choose “Retry pending correction” next to it. How many model calls were used is under “Details and usage”.
在实录里选句出题: Pick sentences for questions in live class
逐字稿下面的选择栏: The selection bar under the transcript
勾选句子或划选文字，或点「最近一段」选中最近约 1200 个字符，再点「选中内容: Tick sentences or select text, or choose “Latest stretch” to select the latest 1200 characters or so, then choose “Create questions from selection”. When a button is grey, hovering or focusing it says why (nothing selected, too few characters, at most 400 sentences at a time).
实录结束后保存为资料与课堂笔记: Save a class as a source with class notes
先在「课堂实录」里开始或打开一场实录，这一项才会出现。: Start or open a recording in Live class first; this item appears then.
结束实录后随时可以点「保存为资料」，不会因为润色或译文没做完而点不了：它会先补完: After you end the recording you can save at any time; it is never greyed out because the polish or translations are unfinished. Saving first finishes the polish and the translations, then keeps the transcript and the class notes. If the polish made no notes, they are written from the transcript. Anything that could not be finished is written in Tasks.
觉得这道题不好，点题目下方的「修题」：点一个常见的问题（或者自己写一句），后台助: Think a question is bad? Choose “Improve question” below it: pick a common problem (or write a line of your own) and the background assistant edits the card directly; one step undoes it.
在「修题」框里写好一句话，点「存为我的常用语句」，它就和内置的常见问题排在一起，: Write a line in the “Improve question” box and choose “Save as my phrase”: it sits next to the built-in common problems, and one click fills the box with it next time. The ✕ on each one removes it (undo for a few seconds). Up to 12 phrases of 200 characters each, saved in the library settings.
先在「复习全书」里打开一本书。: First open a book in Review book.
把答题模板、题干信号矩阵、易混对照、公式和术语卡排成密密的两栏一页，每条都标着书: Answer templates, the question-signal matrix, confusable pairs, formulas and term cards on one dense two-column page, each saying which point of the book it comes from; choose a point’s number to go back to it in the book. “Print / save as PDF” prints it as two-column A4 pages, and “Download .html” saves one page that opens offline (a phone too). While the book has no term cards, answer templates or formulas the item is not there, nor while the course’s custom plan (Customize in depth) leaves out the cheat sheet; a plan without formulas or the index likewise leaves the formula page, the glossary and the term cards by chapter out of the lookup pages. Tick them again in “Your custom plan” on the course settings and they are back. Export… has the same download; the whole book can be saved as such a page too, see “Export the review book”.
「更多 › 导出…」把整本书存成三种：一个 Markdown 文件（给 Pand: “More › Export…” saves the whole book in three ways: one Markdown file (for Pandoc), a zip of files, or “Whole book (.html)”, one page that opens offline and prints cleanly: each chapter starts a new page, sources stand at the end of the chapter, it reads on a phone, and the button says about how many A4 pages it is. When you share it, tick “Leave quotes from the materials out of the book page”: the words quoted from your materials, in the footnotes and in the concepts of the answer key, are left out and only the source (its title) stays; this applies to the book page only. Which questions are printed and whether the answer key is in are the same for all three.
课程有定制方案、也生成了复习全书之后，「课程设置」的「你的定制」下面列出方案里每: Once a course has a custom plan and a review book, “Your custom plan” in the course settings lists the readiness of each chapter of the plan: a thin bar is the share of solid points, and hovering shows how many points are explained, have questions, were practised and are solid; a chapter the book has not written yet says “Not built”. “Fill gaps” first says what it would do and roughly how many model calls, and only “Start” begins; it starts existing jobs only (explanations, questions, variants), and the progress is in Jobs.
深度定制（资料那一行）: Customize in depth (on a book's row)
150 页以上的资料那一行: The row of a document of 150 pages or more
生成总纲前先问要不要深度定制: Asked before generating the outline: customize in depth?
先在首页点「总纲」，打开这门课的总纲页。: First open the course's Outline page: choose “Outline” on the home page.
长资料一次只显示一章，打开更快：有章节的书按它自己的章（和「资料」页「查看 N: A long material shows one chapter at a time, so it opens fast: a book with chapters reads by its own chapters (the same as “Show N chapters” on the Sources page), one without them in parts of 20 pages. “Contents” lists every chapter; click one to switch to it, and expand it to see its pages. At the end of the text are “Previous chapter” and “Next chapter”. Going to a page from a citation, a practice run or “Show N chapters” switches to its chapter by itself, and “Find in text” also lists the matches in other chapters.
在阅读器工具栏最右边的「更多」里点「翻译…」：把这一页或这一章译成中文或英文，译: In the reader toolbar, open More at the far right and choose “Translate…”: it translates this page or chapter into Chinese or English, with the translation shown beside the paragraphs. Translation runs in the background, you can keep reading, and translations you already have need no model.
数出这几页关联了多少道题、几道到期，点一下就开始练；这几页还没有题时，同一个面板: Counts how many questions are linked to these pages and how many are due, and starts practising with one click; when these pages have no questions yet, the same panel can make some. Click the small arrow right of “Make questions”, or press P while reading.
打开 PDF 资料后，在工具栏最右边的「更多」里把「显示方式」切到「原始 PDF: With a PDF material open, switch the view to “Original PDF” in More at the far right of the toolbar to see the pages of the original file. Ask by page in “More › Study tools”, turn pages with the page buttons, and tap a preset to ask at once. Without the original file, add it first with “Add the original file”.
在阅读里选中一段原文，「学习工具」会自己打开（也可以在工具栏最右边的「更多」里点: Select a passage while reading and “Study tools” opens by itself (you can also open it from More at the far right of the toolbar); you can then ask about that passage, and there are one-tap questions such as “I didn’t get it” and “Give an example”. Answers are kept only while the reader is open; save one as an annotation to keep it.
阅读时工具栏里红色的「AI 出题」按钮：用整份资料出题。: The red “Make questions” button in the toolbar while reading: make questions from the whole material.
列出这份资料里你答错或还没巩固的题（和「错题与待巩固」页是同一批记录），当前章节: Lists the questions of this material you got wrong or have not consolidated yet (the same records as the “Mistakes & weak points” page), the current chapter’s first and the rest after. Each question can be practised (you come back here afterwards) or opened in the text at the passage it asks about. When there are none it says so in one line.
把当前这一章按它的标题画成一棵树（章 › 节 › 小节），不用模型、不花 tok: Draws the current chapter as a tree from its headings (chapter › section › sub-section), with no model and no tokens. Click a node to jump there, and the arrow folds a branch. To make it finer, click “Refine in the main chat” and the main chat completes it from the chapter’s pages.
阅读器的工具栏只留「目录」「AI 出题」「错题」「思维导图」，其余都在最右边的「: The reader’s toolbar keeps only Contents, Make questions, Mistakes and Mind map; everything else is in More at the far right: the view (Read / Text / Original PDF), Find in text (Ctrl/⌘ F), Translate…, Display settings…, Study tools, Mastery and coverage, AI contents…, Rename…, today’s related to-dos, the question sets that use this material, and Download the original file.
在这份资料里找一个词，也会列出其他章节里的结果。按 Ctrl/⌘ F 直接打开，: Finds a word in this material and also lists the results in other chapters. Press Ctrl/⌘ F to open it directly, or choose “Find in text” in More.
字号、版心宽度、字体、背景、下划线，和中英对照译文怎么显示，都在「更多」的「显示: Text size, line width, typeface, background, underline, and how bilingual translations are shown are all in More › “Display settings…”; a change applies to every place you read.
自动解析的标题不满意时，在「更多」里点「AI 整理目录…」：它会打开「目录」，底: When the automatic headings are not good enough, choose “AI contents…” in More: it opens the Contents, and at the bottom you can have the AI tidy the full contents or only find the chapters (cheaper). It estimates the cost first and calls the model once only after you confirm.
把这一阶段的资料交给主会话一步步讲清楚、边讲边问，不懂的地方当场追问。: Hand this stage’s materials to the main chat to explain step by step and check your understanding as you go, with follow-up questions on the spot.
像面试一样一问一答、追问到底，检验这一阶段是不是真能讲出来；交卷后给出逐题点评。: An interview-style oral check with back-and-forth follow-ups to test whether you can explain this stage in your own words, with feedback on every question after you submit.
每门课按哪几个阶段学、过关宽严怎么算，以及当前阶段「也可以」用哪些功能；默认是课: The stages a course is learned by, how strict each stage’s gate is, and which other StudyHub features you can also try in the current stage. It defaults to Course study, works unchanged if left alone, and can be edited right on the card or shaped with the main chat.
只保存了提取出的文字的资料，可以补上原文件：打开工具栏最右边的「更多」，PDF: A material that kept only its extracted text can get its original file back: open More at the far right of the toolbar. For a PDF, the "Original PDF" row says "No original file" and clicking it is how you add it (other formats have "Add the original file…"). Point to where the file is (only the path is remembered, no space used, however big the file) or copy it into the library (up to 40 MB). The saved text, citations and questions do not change. A PDF converted from a path on this computer remembers where its original is; sending a page to the main chat from the reader then includes the file path and page number. If the file goes missing or is changed, the reader shows a notice above the text.
